name: LOSARTAN / HYDROCHLOROTHIAZIDE 50/12.5MG 30 TABLETS
description: Losartan/hydrochlorothiazide is a combination medication used to treat hypertension (high blood pressure). Losartan is an angiotensin II receptor antagonist that relaxes blood vessels, while hydrochlorothiazide is a diuretic that helps remove excess fluid and salt from the body, thereby lowering blood pressure. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
